Local-only viewer (Blob URL + WebGL). For .splat / .ksplat we set fileType from extension.
Drop a file or use Select file.
Controls
Orbit mode
New: Double‑click a splat to set the orbit center. Enable Zoom‑to‑cursor for dolly‑to‑mouse.
  • Rotate: Left mouse drag / 1-finger drag
  • Pan: Right mouse drag (or Shift + left drag) / 2-finger drag
  • Zoom: Mouse wheel / Trackpad pinch
FPS mode (Spark controls)
  • Move: WASD, arrows
  • Up/Down: Space / C
  • Speed: Shift faster, Ctrl slower, Caps Lock very fast
  • Look: drag on canvas; Scroll wheel moves forward/back
Tips
  • If zoom feels too fast/slow, switch Render preset or FPS mode.
  • LOD presets here adjust SparkRenderer render parameters (maxStdDev, minAlpha, maxPixelRadius).
